killedBy: hud: the stats page does NOT retain the tab across documents, which is what keeps it out of storage
why: Moves the tab memory OUT of the HUD instance and into state that outlives it -- a global here, `storage.ts` in the version someone would actually write. The owner ruled this memory lasts the sitting and is gone on reload: it is a convenience within one visit, not a preference the player set, and a persisted version would make the first screen of a visit depend on something they did days earlier. The whole block is the find string because a faithful mutation has to both READ and WRITE the outliving store -- an earlier version patched only the read, so nothing ever wrote the global, the fallback always applied and it SURVIVED. Nothing about a single mount can see this either way, which is why its test builds a whole second HUD.
